info.title: Bazaar internal Alpha API
info.description: Implemented Alpha contract. Provisioned password accounts and optional Google Gmail registration; email-code APIs are unavailable until a sender is installed. Simulated settlement and seller image uploads; no wallet or real payments. Every response returns X-Request-Id; errors contain code, retryable and the same requestId. Private/auth responses no-store. Admission saturation returns 503 OVERLOADED with retryable=true and Cache-Control: no-store before authentication/database work; POST /health/live is exempt. Write retries must preserve the original payload and idempotency key.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional diagnostic ID. Invalid values are replaced; the effective ID is returned in the response header and error body.

session.name: bazaar_session
session.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/; Secure outside loopback HTTP; fixed 12h.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Obtained from login/session; required for authenticated writes in addition to exact Origin.

WalletAddress.description: Normalized 20-byte nonzero address. Historical order addresses never follow current account wallet binding.

WalletIdentityView.description: Current account binding only. Wallet interfaces remain feature gated during implementation.

Error.description: Database connectivity or pool availability failures return HTTP 503 with code DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE and retryable=true. Retry writes with the original body and idempotency key; a failed response does not prove the transaction was rolled back. Driver messages and connection details are never returned.

amount.description: Positive decimal string, at most 20 integer digits. Currency scales from POST /currencies; reject excess scale, never round.

url.description: Stable application GET path; order URLs require participant authorization.

canEdit.description: Whether content edits are currently permitted; one-off listings lock after the first order.

priceUsd.description: Unrounded USD reference decimal string; null without a quote. Does not change original price.

ProductCommitment.description: Seller supplied public statement. Version 1. No private fulfillment or ownership certification.

PhysicalListingCreate.description: During the compat rollout, commitment may be omitted; the published listing remains visible but purchaseEligible is false until the seller adds it. With LISTING_COMMITMENT_POLICY=enforce, omission returns INVALID_INPUT. A supplied commitment is always validated.

replacementOfListingId.description: Optional old one-off listing being replaced. Active stock blocks replacement; accepted replacement awaits administrator review.

DigitalListingCreate.description: During the compat rollout, commitment may be omitted; the published listing remains visible but purchaseEligible is false until the seller adds it. With LISTING_COMMITMENT_POLICY=enforce, omission returns INVALID_INPUT. A supplied commitment is always validated.

supplyMode.description: Single reserves one digital entitlement at order creation; cancellation releases it, completion consumes it, and a refund keeps it unavailable. Delivery reference and access code remain private order data.

priceAmount.description: Positive only. Currency scale: CNY 2, USDT 6, ETH 18, SOL 9; reject excess scale, never round.

testnetPriceAmount.description: Independent positive BZTEST price, maximum six decimals and uint256 atoms. Never converted from the ordinary quote.

sourceAsOf.description: null: upstream does not disclose price timestamp

acceptedAt.description: Server-recorded buyer accept event, not external access activation.

quoteId.description: Required for later price-sorted pages when currency is omitted. With a currency filter and no quoteId, sort uses original-currency amounts, returns quote=null and needs no quoteId on later pages. A supplied quoteId still selects that FX snapshot until expiresAt.

sourceAsOf.description: null: upstream does not disclose price timestamp

typedData.description: Dedicated server EIP-712 domain/type for wallet binding or seller payout. Purpose, account, current wallet, binding version, chain/escrow, nonce, session, recovery epoch and expiresAtMilliseconds are fixed. Payout consumption uses /web3/payout/confirm.

signature.description: Required for binding. Unbinding uses the independent account proof and requires no old-wallet signature.

amount.description: Independent positive BZTEST price, maximum six decimals and uint256 atoms. Never converted from the ordinary quote.
Independent positive BZTEST price, maximum six decimals and uint256 atoms. Never converted from the ordinary quote.

payment.description: Immutable historical order tuple only; not a payment authorization. Current binding never changes these addresses.

intentId.description: Latest intent identifier; signature and status must be obtained from authenticated read.

TestnetOrderTerms.description: Immutable seller/price snapshot, readable without a current payout confirmation. Not a payment permit; intent creation/replacement belongs to T04.

typedData.description: EIP-712 message uses JSON strings for uint256 fields.

byteSize.description: Decimal bytes. PDF/PNG/JPEG additionally capped at 20000000.

uploadToken.description: Sensitive one-use upload bearer credential; never grants download or file publication.

EvidenceResult.description: Controlled bilateral evidence metadata; never contains storage locators, signatures or reusable file grants.

EvidenceReadResult.description: Bilateral evidence plus scoped review metadata; delivery references never grant bytes.

ReviewResult.description: Audited station-only review event; fundsAffected is false.

RequestId.description: Effective request correlation ID generated or accepted by the server.
